entries.land_location_as_stated: on the shore of Silver Lake, in the rapidly suburbanizing South Shore area of Massachusetts
entries.description: A 100-acre farm of woods, swamp, cranberry bog and gardens on Silver Lake in the South Shore area of Massachusetts. Two partners are the only residents. It offers camping, open space and farmwork experience to women and children, and arranges longer apprenticeships and stays for short-term large groups. The owners are working to organize a land trust for the property.
entries.raw_text: FEATHERS FARM Box 19, Bryantville, MA 02327 (617)585-3826. My partner & I are the only residents of Feathers Farm, 100 acres of woods, swamp, cranberry bog & gardens on the shore of Silver Lake, in the rapidly suburbanizing South Shore area of Massachusetts. We have camping facilities/open space/ farmwork experience to women and children. We are currently working to organize support and resources for a land trust to control this property. We have found lesbian separatism to be unworkable and alienating approach to this endeavor and expect unconditional acceptance of this from our visitors (whom we welcome AND encourage). We request that visitors bring their own food & donate $4/night camping fee, flexible. We often work out other arrangements for longer term apprenticeships or short term large groups. It is helpful if visits are preceeded by at least a phonecall, preferably a letter.
entries.notes: Type: Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ("My partner & I are the only residents"). The land trust is only planned ("working to organize support and resources for a land trust"), so it is not coded Land Trust. Residents: 2. Land: Box 19 is a PO box, so land street and zip are left blank; land state MA comes from "South Shore area of Massachusetts". Accepted groups: "women and children" in a pre-1986 listing gives lesbian women, non-lesbian women, girl children and boy children. Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency from "farmwork experience" and the cranberry bog and gardens; Workshops/education from "longer term apprenticeships". Separatism is rejected ("lesbian separatism to be unworkable and alienating"), so it is not coded. "phone-call" is split at a line break and joined here as "phonecall"; the original may have been hyphenated.

entries.description: A 113-acre community of Maine mountains and woodland with housing and permanent structures. Four lesbians live and work on the land. Parcels are available for sale or building, with space for camping, hiking and raspberry picking. It welcomes new members and residents, girl children, non-lesbian women, and lesbians interested in buying land.
entries.raw_text: WOMONGROUND Rt 1, Box 2420, Troy, ME 04987. 113 acres of Maine mountains/woodland. Parcels available for sale and/or building. Also plenty of space for camping, hiking, raspberry picking. Will answer all letters promptly. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women, lesbians interested in buying land. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 113 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, women working and living on the land.
entries.notes: Land: Rt 1 is a rural route, so the mailing address is the land. Residents: "4 lesbians" together with "women working and living on the land" gives 4. Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative, because four lesbians live on the land and they welcome "new members/residents". Accepted groups: girl children and non-lesbian women are named; lesbian women are coded as residents and as "lesbians interested in buying land". No boy children are named. No focuses are stated.

entries.description: Twenty acres with a creek, woods and open land, and two lesbian-built dwellings with no plumbing or electricity. The land is owned by a lesbian collective, none of whom live there now. It is currently rented to heterosexual tenants, and the owners want lesbian renters. It is 15 miles from a town with jobs.
entries.raw_text: GENEROUS EARTH LAND Box 51A, Hinesburg, VT 05461. 20 acres, creek, woods, open. 2 dyke-built dwellings, one large, one small. No plumbing or electricity. None of the dyke collective owners live there now. It's rented to hets. Interested in dyke renters. 15 miles from town with jobs. Write before visiting.
entries.notes: Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative is a judgment call. The land is collectively owned ("dyke collective owners") but no owner lives there, and it does not fit Land Fund/Seeking Land because the group already holds the land. Residents: 0, because "None of the dyke collective owners live there now"; the heterosexual tenants ("rented to hets") are not counted as members. Land: Box 51A is treated as a PO box, so land fields are left blank; the listing does not say where the land is. Accepted groups: "Interested in dyke renters" gives lesbian women. No focuses are stated.

entries.description: A working homestead farm with secluded land and campsites. It offers year-round space to women needing a retreat or temporary living situation, cross-country ski weekends, and summer work exchange, and hopes to build visitor cabins. It runs an all-lesbian maple sugar bush, works with a draft horse, raises dairy goats and chickens, and grows nearly all its own food organically. It welcomes community members, leases land to women wanting to build a cabin or tipi, and offers workshops. The listing continues on the next page.
entries.raw_text: GREENHOPE Box 226, E Hardwick, VT 05836. (802)533-7772. At present we are a working homestead farm. We offer year round space to women needing retreat or temporary living situation. We have gorgeous secluded land and campsites. Hope to build visitor cabins this summer. Women from the Boston area visit almost every weekend. Right now we are offering x-country ski weekends — $35 plus meals is the fee. In summer we offer work exchange. We have an all lesbian maple sugar bush — the only one I know of. We work with a draft horse, raise dairy goats and chickens. We are vegetarians raising nearly all our food organically here.
